name: BSP_UnitInstance_UpdateEngineAudio
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this, float scaledDelta), RET 4, body 008252C0..0082544B, 128 instructions, no flow gaps. First of the three timed sub-updates 008255B0 calls at 00825D5A. Gate: byte +9C4h (008252CA). Selects one of three 0x24-apart settings blocks in the 00424C40 singleton by IsKindOf: 0Eh -> +5E0h, 8 -> +604h, else +5BCh; only +8 in the block is read, the smoothing rate. Then 0042AC60(&f_BC4h, byte_5Dh ? 0 : fabsf(f_980h), rate*delta). Pushes f_BC4h as the parameter 'rpm' (00D08688) into the emitters at +BBCh and +BB8h through vtable +1Ch, and 0092D730(controller)/0080FC30(this) as 'param00' (00D09998) into +BB4h with no clamp and no zero guard. Calls vtable +0Ch (0.0f) on +BC0h only while +5Dh is set. No position, heading or speed integration. docs/UNIT_TIMED_SUBUPDATES.md

name: BSP_UnitInstance_ApplyPropellerTurnAssist
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. float10 __thiscall(unit, float yaw_rate) RET 4. The only recovered consumer of the propeller load at unit+1030h: while the load is positive and |rate| is under settings[220h], the rate is pushed away from zero by min(|rate|, settings[224h]*(settings[220h]-|rate|))*load, keeping the sign of the input (00825E36 tests rate < 0.0f against 00D7A218). Outside that window the rate is returned unchanged. Called from 0092E8C0 at 0092E966. docs/UNIT_FORCE_COMMANDS.md
